integrity: The exact argument is analytic; the bundled numerical replay checks the algebraic contact parameter and displayed decimal values but is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for the real two-dimensional \(p=3\) Cesàro norm. It gives one optimal Euclidean pullback but does not classify every optimal linear map. An older equivalent statement under different convex-geometry terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Exact Euclidean Banach--Mazur distance of the two-dimensional \(p=3\) Cesàro space
